Membra ciuitatis 267. distorta animorum distortorum sunt indicia 44. familiae eiusdem 404
Memoria aui prasentis praesenti potentia nō extinguitur 61. Cyro quanta 134

page.notes: Right margin shows only fragments of entries from the facing page (M..., Mef, fimu, 444, plafi, tica, omni, metb, mo, 64, 345, deinc, de co, duce, 457, cipis, lina, publ) and is not transcribed. Several numerals are uncertain due to the small type and are not marked individually.
